主要内容: On July 27, 2018, Geospace Technologies Corporation acquired Quantum Technology Sciences, Inc., a Florida-based tactical security and surveillance systems solutions provider, through a merger of the Company’s subsidiary with and into Quantum, with Quantum as the surviving corporation. The acquisition purchase price for Quantum consisted of a cash down payment at closing of approximately $4.4 million and contingent earn-out payments of up to $23.5 million over a four-year period.
